en.headline: John Lee to visit Shenzhen for APEC meetings from Tuesday
en.dek: The Chief Executive will attend the CEO Summit and Economic Leaders’ Meeting over three days, saying APEC economies account for 87 per cent of Hong Kong’s external trade.
body: Chief Executive John Lee will travel to Shenzhen on Tuesday for a three-day visit to attend APEC meetings, a government spokesman said on Monday.

Lee is scheduled to join the APEC CEO Summit on Tuesday and Wednesday, including thematic sessions and the opening ceremony, and the APEC Economic Leaders’ Meeting on Thursday. He is expected to return to Hong Kong on Thursday evening.

The spokesman said Lee would be accompanied by Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau and Director of the Chief Executive’s Office Carol Yip. During the trip Lee plans bilateral meetings with other leaders.

Lee said APEC member economies are important trading partners for Hong Kong, accounting for as much as 87 per cent of the city’s external trade. He pledged that the government would continue to strengthen connectivity with Asia-Pacific economies and leverage Hong Kong’s role as a super-connector.

zh.headline: 李家超周二起赴深圳出席APEC會議一連三日
zh.dek: 行政長官將出席工商峰會及經濟領袖會議，指APEC成員經濟體佔本港對外貿易達87%。
body: 政府發言人周一表示，行政長官李家超將於周二前往深圳，一連三日出席APEC相關會議。
李家超將出席周二及周三的APEC工商峰會，包括專題研討及開幕典禮，以及周四的APEC經濟領袖會議，預計周四晚上回港。
發言人指，商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺及行政長官辦公室主任葉文娟將陪同前往。行程期間，李家超會與其他領袖舉行雙邊會談。
李家超表示，APEC成員經濟體是香港的重要貿易伙伴，佔本港對外貿易高達87%。他承諾政府會繼續加強與亞太經濟體的連繫，並發揮香港作為超級聯繫人的角色。
